To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the flow pattern of the annulus and the draft tube in the ASALR is significantly different from that of the commercial gas-solides internal airlift loop reactors.The radial distribution of the mean voidage in the annulus region was influenced by the superficial gas velocity,while the radial distribution of the particle velocity was influenced by both the superficial gas velocity and the configuration of the annulus ring sparger.The migration of particles in annulus region and draft tube was dilute-phase and dense-phase transport,

the novel gas-solid annulus-sparged loop reactor is a new type of reactor for gas-liquid-solid system, and the mean voidage in the annulus increases with increasing superficial gas in the annulus, the radial distribution of particle in the draft tube is influenced by the configuration ring sparger, the migration of particles in draft tube is dense phase transport and the flow resistance in draft tube is primarily determined by the draft tube clearance from the bottom of ASALR.

the mean void age of the annulus increased with increasing superficial velocity in the annuli, the particle velocity was considerably higher at the outer wall of draft tube than that at the inner wall of draft tube, particle velocity almost kept constant with axial position, the flow resistance of the circulating particles was more significant in bottom than in annulus and draft tubes.

the flow pattern and hydrodynamics of the novel gas-solides annulus-sparged Airlift loop reactor,which provides a theoretical reference for its application and design.
the hydrodynamics in the novel gas-solid annulus-sparged loop reactor, which can be used for the design, operation, and scale-up of the ASALRs.

the hydrodynamic characteristics of gas-solid flow in the annulus region and the draft tube region,as well as the flow resistance of the circulating particles.The results of our study can provide a theoretical foundation for further study and application of ASALR.

the proposed model is capable of predicting the flow behavior and hydrodynamics in the ASALR.
the ASALR was a promising reactor for the gas-solid reactions, and the proposed model could be applied for the prediction of the hydrodynamics in the ASALR.
the proposed novel gas-solides ASALR was a promising reactor for gas-solids reaction.

the ASALR was a novel reactor for gas-solids reaction and the theoretical model proposed in this paper could provide a theoretical basis for the application and design of the ASALL reactor.

the proposed ASALR is a promising reactor in gas-solids system,which is characterized by the high gas holdup in the annulus region,the high particle velocity in the annular region,low particle circulating velocity,low flow resistance,smaller axial dispersion and high efficiency of gas-solids contacting.

the proposed model can predict the hydrodynamic characteristics of the annulus,which can be used for the design and scale-up of the ASALRTs.
